items.name: eIDAS Regulation
items.scope: Levels of electronic signature (simple, advanced, qualified) and trust services.
items.notes: Technical considerations only, not legal advice. Engineering implications: identity assurance level, signature evidence, timestamps, integrity. AdES/QES need a qualified provider. Statute not fetched this session.

items.name: UK eIDAS regulations and Electronic Communications Act 2000
items.scope: UK trust services and evidential treatment of electronic signatures.
items.notes: Technical considerations only. Text not fetched; counsel to confirm current position.

items.name: US ESIGN Act
items.scope: Consent to electronic records, intent to sign, record retention and reproduction.
items.notes: Technical considerations only. Engineering implications: consent capture with text version, copy available to signer, retained reproducible record. Not fetched this session.

items.name: Uniform Electronic Transactions Act
items.scope: State counterpart to ESIGN: attribution and retention of electronic records.
items.notes: Enacted per state with variation; technical considerations only. Not fetched this session.

items.name: UAE Federal Decree-Law 46/2021
items.scope: Electronic transactions, signatures, seals and trust services.
items.notes: Technical considerations only; text not fetched and recalled details are unverified. Counsel to confirm.

items.name: GDPR
items.jurisdiction: EU (UK GDPR is a separate text)
items.scope: Lawful basis, retention limits, erasure, residency for signer personal data.
items.notes: Technical considerations only. Reconcile erasure requests with audit and evidence retention; per-tenant retention policy.

items.name: PAdES (ETSI EN 319 142)
items.scope: Baseline profiles B-B, B-T, B-LT, B-LTA for PDF signatures.
items.notes: Profile choice depends on legal level; signpdf covers B-B only. Not fetched this session.

items.name: RFC 3161 timestamping
items.notes: Optional for simple e-signatures; recommended when long-term validity matters.

items.name: ISO 32000 PDF
items.scope: PDF coordinate space, CropBox and rotation used for field placement.
items.notes: Basis for storing relative field coordinates; PDF/A archival is a separate decision.

items.name: OWASP ASVS
items.scope: Verification requirements for auth, session, access control, upload and API security.

disclaimer: Domain knowledge, technical considerations only, not legal advice. Confirm applicability per jurisdiction with a qualified reviewer.
